intro: A row filter limits the rows of a table someone sees; a column mask shows them something else in place of a column. Each is made to a person, a service account or a group, on one table.

filters.label: Filters
filters.tableHelp: Choose an environment first; applied on Enter.
filters.tableDotted: Write the table as namespace.table, such as gold.station_ranking.

row-filter.title: Row filters
row-filter.noMatch: No row filter matches these filters.

column-mask.title: Column masks
column-mask.noMatch: No column mask matches these filters.

deleteFilterOf: Delete the row filter on {{table}} for {{who}}
deleteMaskOf: Delete the mask of {{column}} on {{table}} for {{who}}
deleteFilterText: <who/> then sees every row of <table/> that their grants allow.
deleteMaskText: <who/> then sees <column/> of <table/> as it is stored.

addDialog.title: Add filter or mask
addDialog.name: Name
addDialog.filterHelp: Which rows they see: comparisons, AND, OR, NOT, current_user() and has_group('name'), such as region = 'EU'.
addDialog.maskHelp: What they see instead: the same, plus substr, || and md5, such as '***' || substr(email, -4).
addDialog.managed: An access file manages {{environment}}: add this in {{file}} instead.
